cohort: 220 women aged 18-40 years undergoing elective caesarean section with spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Prophylactic phenylephrine infusion at 50mg/minute resulted in significantly less bradycardia compared to a 100mg/minute infusion rate, with no significant difference in the frequency of hypotension between the groups.
mod_finding: A 50mg/minute phenylephrine infusion rate during spinal anaesthesia for elective caesarean sections is associated with significantly less bradycardia compared to a 100mg/minute rate.
